alex: Heads-up — CI started failing on audit-validator after the KMS tweak rolled yesterday. 3 golden fixtures erroring out with `encryption_context mismatch`.
maya: link to the failing job?
alex: https://ci.internal/1954/job/42
alex: failing tests: `audit_event_schema_test::golden_rbac_fixture_v2`, `audit_event_schema_test::golden_kms_fixture_v3`, `audit_event_schema_test::golden_customer_stream_sample`
alex: stack:```
error: event failed validation: unknown field `key_version` in `encryption.metadata`
at audit_validator::validate_event (src/validator.rs:211)
``` 
maya: hmm, we added key_version to the KMS envelope yesterday (PR #987). Validator might be strict about unknown fields.
zach: yep — validator uses Serde with deny_unknown_fields on some nested structs. quick fix options:
- loosen the struct to allow extra fields (#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")][serde(deny_unknown_fields=false)])
- bump the schema and rotate golden fixtures
- add a temporary compatibility shim that strips unknowns before validation
alex: which affects customers? any customer-facing audit streams that we promised stable schema for?
jordan: customer-facing streams could break if they run our schema checks client-side. enterprise teams ingesting raw audit events might see rejects.
eva: for risk: can we hotfix validator to ignore unknown fields for `encryption.metadata` only? minimal blast radius.
zach: sample patch (rough):
```
#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct EncryptionMetadata {
  algorithm: Option<String>,
  key_id: Option<String>,
  #[serde(flatten)]
  other: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>, // allow key_version
}
```
maya: i can open a PR for that + add a unit test which covers `key_version` preserved but not failing. will also update the golden fixture comments.
alex: prioritization — CI blocking on main, so need fast path.
maya: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1023 — small change, tests added. run locally:
`./scripts/run_audit_validator_tests.sh --filter golden_rbac_fixture_v2`
maya: note: the failure also surfaced in `audit-golden-sync` nightly job, so we should run full golden set after merge.
infra-bot: Deployment started for infra-service@commit: d1f4c8b (user: ci-bot)
alex: is this ok to ship without schema bump? do we need to announce to customers?
jordan: no schema bump required for now; it's additive metadata. but we should notify enterprise customers that new KMS envelope contains `key_version` and that validators will be tolerant.
eva: will draft a short changelog blurb and send to customer-success.
zach: long-term we should update the audit schema doc and add a note about unknown field policy. also add evaluators to CI to check for accidental breaking changes.
alex: tests to add before merge:
- golden fixtures updated for v3 KMS sample
- CI smoke run in infra-cluster (canary)
maya: adding both. running smoke locally now.
alex: quick repro command for infra folks:
```
cat fixtures/golden/kms_v3.json | ./bin/audit-validate --schema schemas/audit_event.json
```
maya: local run passed after patch.
alex: can we canary to prod in eu-small first?
infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: infra-service eu-small group at 1954000200
maya: merging PR once CI green. will kick off nightly full-golden run.
alex: leaving follow-up: create GH issue to track schema doc update + add evaluator (assign zach).
zach: ack. i'll own the follow-up.
eva: i'll handle the customer note and send to CS.
alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup!
infra-bot: Deployment completed for infra-service@d1f4c8b (canary eu-small)"
